comment: dothrow.c return_throw_to_inv() 1904: a debug Valkyrie wishes for an aklys, wields it (tethered; her dagger stays the alternate weapon), takes off her small shield and starts two-weapon combat, then throws the aklys upward. throwit() 1586-1587: a returning missile thrown up 'hits the ceiling and returns to your hand', and return_throw_to_inv() rewields it and, since the throw ended dual-wielding, calls set_twoweap(TRUE).
